```typescriptreact
                      className="px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-gradient-zen hover:opacity-80 transition-all duration-300"
                    >
                      SAFE MAX
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {asset.totalBorrowed === "-" && (
                  <p className="text-sm text-red-400">
                    You need to supply tokens and enable them as collateral before you can borrow {asset.symbol} from this pool.
                  </p>
                )}

                <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Borrow APY</p>
                      <Info className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400" />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.borrowAPY}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Total APY</p>
                      <Info className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400" />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.borrowAPY}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={handleBorrow}
                  disabled={asset.totalBorrowed === "-" || !borrowAmount || parseFloat(borrowAmount) <= 0}
                  className={`w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ${
                    asset.totalBorrowed !== "-" && borrowAmount && parseFloat(borrowAmount) > 0
                      ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 via-green-400 to-cyan-400 hover:from-yellow-500 hover:via-green-500 hover:to-cyan-500 text-white hover-glow"
                      : "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
                  }`}
                >
                  {asset.totalBorrowed === "-"
                    ? "Enter valid amount"
                    : borrowAmount && parseFloat(borrowAmount) > 0
                    ? "Borrow"
                    : "Enter an amount"}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {activeTab === "repay" && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4">
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={repayAmount}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const value = e.target.value;
                        if (value === "" || /^\d*\.?\d*$/.test(value)) {
                          setRepayAmount(value);
                        }
                      }}
                      placeholder="0.00"
                      className="w-full bg-transparent text-2xl font-semibold text-white placeholder-gray-500 outline-none mb-2"
                    />
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">
                        ${repayAmount ? (parseFloat(repayAmount) * 60000).toFixed(2) : "0"}
                      </p>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-yellow-400/20 via-green-400/20 to-cyan-400/20 flex items-center justify-center text-sm border border-green-400/30 shadow-lg shadow-green-500/20 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110">
                          {asset.icon}
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.symbol}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Borrow balance 0</p>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setRepayAmount("0")}
                      className="px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-gradient-zen hover:opacity-80 transition-all duration-300"
                    >
                      MAX
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Borrow APY</p>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.borrowAPY}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Health factor</p>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.healthFactor}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Liquidation at &lt;1.0</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={handleRepay}
                  disabled={!repayAmount || parseFloat(repayAmount) <= 0}
                  className={`w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ${
                    repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0
                      ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 via-green-400 to-cyan-400 hover:from-yellow-500 hover:via-green-500 hover:to-cyan-500 text-white hover-glow"
                      : "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
                  }`}
                >
                  {repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0 ? "Repay" : "Enter an amount"}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Modals */}
      <SupplyModal
        isOpen={supplyModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setSupplyModalOpen(false)}
        asset={{
          symbol: asset.symbol,
          name: asset.name,
          icon: asset.icon,
          balance: "0",
          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      <WithdrawModal
        isOpen={withdrawModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setWithdrawModalOpen(false)}
        asset={{
          symbol: asset.symbol,
          name: asset.name,
          icon: asset.icon,
          balance: "0",
          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      {borrowModalOpen && (
        <BorrowModal
          isOpen={borrowModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setBorrowModalOpen(false)}
          asset={{
            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}
      {repayModalOpen && (
        <RepayModal
          isOpen={repayModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setRepayModalOpen(false)}
          asset={{
            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, Info, Copy, ExternalLink, Fuel } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useAccount } from "wagmi";
import SupplyModal from "./SupplyModal";
import WithdrawModal from "./WithdrawModal";
import BorrowModal from "./BorrowModal";
import RepayModal from "./RepayModal";
import { useAssetDetails } from "@/hooks/useAssetDetails";
import { useHealthFactor, useTokenBalance, useSupplyBalance, useAvailableBorrow, useBorrowBalance, usePriceFromOracle } from "@/hooks/useContract";
import { ConfigService } from "@/services/configService";
import { formatUSD, formatBalance } from "@/utils/format";
import { formatUnits } from "viem";
import { getContractAddress } from "@/config/contracts";

interface AssetDetailsViewProps {
  assetSymbol: string;
}

export default function AssetDetailsView({ assetSymbol }: AssetDetailsViewProps) {
  const { isConnected } = useAccount();
  const assetDetails = useAssetDetails(assetSymbol);

  // Fallback if asset not found
  if (!assetDetails) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="text-center py-12">
          <p className="text-white text-lg">Asset {assetSymbol} not found</p>
          <Link href="/markets" className="text-green-400 hover:text-green-300 mt-4 inline-block">
            Back to Markets
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const asset = assetDetails.asset;
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"supply" | "withdraw" | "borrow" | "repay">("supply");
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState<"30D" | "6M" | "1Y">("30D");
  const [showInfo, setShowInfo] = useState<"supply" | "borrow" | null>(null);

  // Form state for each action
  const [supplyAmount, setSupplyAmount] = useState("");
  const [withdrawAmount, setWithdrawAmount] = useState("");
  const [borrowAmount, setBorrowAmount] = useState("");
  const [repayAmount, setRepayAmount] = useState("");

  const [supplyModalOpen, setSupplyModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [withdrawModalOpen, setWithdrawModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [borrowModalOpen, setBorrowModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [repayModalOpen, setRepayModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Get real-time user data
  const { data: healthFactorData } = useHealthFactor(isConnected);
  const { data: walletBalanceRaw } = useTokenBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: supplyBalanceRaw } = useSupplyBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: availableBorrowRaw } = useAvailableBorrow(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: borrowBalanceRaw } = useBorrowBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { price } = usePriceFromOracle(assetSymbol, isConnected);

  // Format balances
  const walletBalance = walletBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(walletBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const supplyBalance = supplyBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(supplyBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const availableBorrow = availableBorrowRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(availableBorrowRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const borrowBalance = borrowBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(borrowBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";

  // Calculate health factor
  const healthFactor = useMemo(() => {
    if (!healthFactorData) return "∞";
    const hf = Number(healthFactorData);
    if (hf === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER || hf > 1e18) return "∞";
    return (hf / 1e18).toFixed(2);
  }, [healthFactorData]);

  const assetAddress = asset.address;
  const explorerUrl = `https://zentrace.io/address/${assetAddress}`;
  
  // Calculate USD values
  const supplyAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!supplyAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(supplyAmount) * price).toFixed(2);

  const withdrawAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!withdrawAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(withdrawAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [withdrawAmount, price]);

  const borrowAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!borrowAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(borrowAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [borrowAmount, price]);

    if (!repayAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(repayAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [repayAmount, price]);

    navigator.clipboard.writeText(assetAddress);

  const handleWithdraw = () => {

            {activeTab === "borrow" && (

                      MAX

                  </div>

                <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                    <div className="text-right">
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.healthFactor}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Liquidation at &lt;1.0</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={handleRepay}
                  disabled={!repayAmount || parseFloat(repayAmount) <= 0}
                  className={`w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ${
                    repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0
                      ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 via-green-400 to-cyan-400 hover:from-yellow-500 hover:via-green-500 hover:to-cyan-500 text-white hover-glow"
                      : "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
                  }`}
                >
                  {repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0 ? "Repay" : "Enter an amount"}
                </button>

            )}

        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Modals */}
      <SupplyModal

          balance: "0",
          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      <WithdrawModal
        isOpen={withdrawModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setWithdrawModalOpen(false)}
        asset={{
          symbol: asset.symbol,
          name: asset.name,
          icon: asset.icon,
          balance: "0",
          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      {borrowModalOpen && (
        <BorrowModal
          isOpen={borrowModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setBorrowModalOpen(false)}
          asset={{
            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}
      {repayModalOpen && (
        <RepayModal
          isOpen={repayModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setRepayModalOpen(false)}
          asset={{
            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}
```
```typescriptreact
    </div>
  );
}

  const { data: borrowBalanceRaw } = useBorrowBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { price } = usePriceFromOracle(assetSymbol, isConnected);

  // Format balances
  const walletBalance = walletBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(walletBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const supplyBalance = supplyBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(supplyBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";

import { useHealthFactor, useTokenBalance, useSupplyBalance, useAvailableBorrow, useBorrowBalance, usePriceFromOracle } from "@/hooks/useContract";
import { ConfigService } from "@/services/configService";
import { formatUSD, formatBalance } from "@/utils/format";
import { formatUnits } from "viem";
import { getContractAddress } from "@/config/contracts";

interface AssetDetailsViewProps {
  assetSymbol: string;
}

export default function AssetDetailsView({ assetSymbol }: AssetDetailsViewProps) {
  const { isConnected } = useAccount();
  const assetDetails = useAssetDetails(assetSymbol);

  // Fallback if asset not found
  if (!assetDetails) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="text-center py-12">
          <p className="text-white text-lg">Asset {assetSymbol} not found</p>
          <Link href="/markets" className="text-green-400 hover:text-green-300 mt-4 inline-block">
            Back to Markets
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const asset = assetDetails.asset;
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"supply" | "withdraw" | "borrow" | "repay">("supply");
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState<"30D" | "6M" | "1Y">("30D");
  const [showInfo, setShowInfo] = useState<"supply" | "borrow" | null>(null);

  // Form state for each action

  const [withdrawAmount, setWithdrawAmount] = useState("");
  const [borrowAmount, setBorrowAmount] = useState("");
  const [repayAmount, setRepayAmount] = useState("");

  const [supplyModalOpen, setSupplyModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [withdrawModalOpen, setWithdrawModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [borrowModalOpen, setBorrowModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [repayModalOpen, setRepayModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Get real-time user data
  const { data: healthFactorData } = useHealthFactor(isConnected);
  const { data: walletBalanceRaw } = useTokenBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: supplyBalanceRaw } = useSupplyBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: availableBorrowRaw } = useAvailableBorrow(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: borrowBalanceRaw } = useBorrowBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { price } = usePriceFromOracle(assetSymbol, isConnected);

  // Format balances
  const walletBalance = walletBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(walletBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const supplyBalance = supplyBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(supplyBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const availableBorrow = availableBorrowRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(availableBorrowRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const borrowBalance = borrowBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(borrowBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";

  // Calculate health factor
  const healthFactor = useMemo(() => {
    if (!healthFactorData) return "∞";
    const hf = Number(healthFactorData);
    if (hf === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER || hf > 1e18) return "∞";
    return (hf / 1e18).toFixed(2);
  }, [healthFactorData]);

  const assetAddress = asset.address;
  const explorerUrl = `https://zentrace.io/address/${assetAddress}`;
  
  // Calculate USD values
  const supplyAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {

    return (parseFloat(supplyAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [supplyAmount, price]);

  const withdrawAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!withdrawAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(withdrawAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [withdrawAmount, price]);

  const borrowAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!borrowAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(borrowAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [borrowAmount, price]);

    if (!repayAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(repayAmount) * price).toFixed(2);

                      className="px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-gradient-zen hover:opacity-80 transition-all duration-300"
                    >
                      SAFE MAX
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {asset.totalBorrowed === "-" && (
                  <p className="text-sm text-red-400">
                    You need to supply tokens and enable them as collateral before you can borrow {asset.symbol} from this pool.
                  </p>
                )}

                <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Borrow APY</p>
                      <Info className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400" />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.borrowAPY}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Total APY</p>
                      <Info className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400" />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.borrowAPY}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={handleBorrow}
                  disabled={asset.totalBorrowed === "-" || !borrowAmount || parseFloat(borrowAmount) <= 0}
                  className={`w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ${
                    asset.totalBorrowed !== "-" && borrowAmount && parseFloat(borrowAmount) > 0
                      ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 via-green-400 to-cyan-400 hover:from-yellow-500 hover:via-green-500 hover:to-cyan-500 text-white hover-glow"
                      : "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
                  }`}
                >
                  {asset.totalBorrowed === "-"
                    ? "Enter valid amount"
                    : borrowAmount && parseFloat(borrowAmount) > 0
                    ? "Borrow"
                    : "Enter an amount"}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {activeTab === "repay" && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4">
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={repayAmount}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const value = e.target.value;
                        if (value === "" || /^\d*\.?\d*$/.test(value)) {
                          setRepayAmount(value);
                        }
                      }}
                      placeholder="0.00"
                      className="w-full bg-transparent text-2xl font-semibold text-white placeholder-gray-500 outline-none mb-2"
                    />
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">
                        ${repayAmount ? (parseFloat(repayAmount) * 60000).toFixed(2) : "0"}
                      </p>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-yellow-400/20 via-green-400/20 to-cyan-400/20 flex items-center justify-center text-sm border border-green-400/30 shadow-lg shadow-green-500/20 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110">
                          {asset.icon}
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.symbol}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Borrow balance 0</p>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setRepayAmount("0")}
                      className="px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-gradient-zen hover:opacity-80 transition-all duration-300"
                    >
                      MAX
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Borrow APY</p>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.borrowAPY}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Health factor</p>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.healthFactor}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Liquidation at &lt;1.0</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={handleRepay}
                  disabled={!repayAmount || parseFloat(repayAmount) <= 0}
                  className={`w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ${
                    repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0
                      ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 via-green-400 to-cyan-400 hover:from-yellow-500 hover:via-green-500 hover:to-cyan-500 text-white hover-glow"
                      : "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
                  }`}
                >
                  {repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0 ? "Repay" : "Enter an amount"}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Modals */}
      <SupplyModal
        isOpen={supplyModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setSupplyModalOpen(false)}
        asset={{
          symbol: asset.symbol,
          name: asset.name,
          icon: asset.icon,
          balance: "0",
          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      <WithdrawModal
        isOpen={withdrawModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setWithdrawModalOpen(false)}
        asset={{
          symbol: asset.symbol,
          name: asset.name,
          icon: asset.icon,
          balance: "0",
          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      {borrowModalOpen && (
        <BorrowModal
          isOpen={borrowModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setBorrowModalOpen(false)}
          asset={{
            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}
      {repayModalOpen && (
        <RepayModal
          isOpen={repayModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setRepayModalOpen(false)}
          asset={{
            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";

import { useHealthFactor, useTokenBalance, useSupplyBalance, useAvailableBorrow, useBorrowBalance, usePriceFromOracle } from "@/hooks/useContract";
import { ConfigService } from "@/services/configService";
import { formatUSD, formatBalance } from "@/utils/format";
import { formatUnits } from "viem";
import { getContractAddress } from "@/config/contracts";

interface AssetDetailsViewProps {
  assetSymbol: string;
}

export default function AssetDetailsView({ assetSymbol }: AssetDetailsViewProps) {
  const { isConnected } = useAccount();
  const assetDetails = useAssetDetails(assetSymbol);

  // Fallback if asset not found
  if (!assetDetails) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="text-center py-12">
          <p className="text-white text-lg">Asset {assetSymbol} not found</p>

            Back to Markets
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const asset = assetDetails.asset;
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"supply" | "withdraw" | "borrow" | "repay">("supply");
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState<"30D" | "6M" | "1Y">("30D");
  const [showInfo, setShowInfo] = useState<"supply" | "borrow" | null>(null);

  const [repayAmount, setRepayAmount] = useState("");

  const [supplyModalOpen, setSupplyModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [withdrawModalOpen, setWithdrawModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [borrowModalOpen, setBorrowModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [repayModalOpen, setRepayModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Get real-time user data
  const { data: healthFactorData } = useHealthFactor(isConnected);
  const { data: walletBalanceRaw } = useTokenBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: supplyBalanceRaw } = useSupplyBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: availableBorrowRaw } = useAvailableBorrow(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: borrowBalanceRaw } = useBorrowBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { price } = usePriceFromOracle(assetSymbol, isConnected);

  // Format balances
  const walletBalance = walletBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(walletBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const supplyBalance = supplyBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(supplyBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const availableBorrow = availableBorrowRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(availableBorrowRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const borrowBalance = borrowBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(borrowBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";

  // Calculate health factor
  const healthFactor = useMemo(() => {
    if (!healthFactorData) return "∞";
    const hf = Number(healthFactorData);
    if (hf === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER || hf > 1e18) return "∞";
    return (hf / 1e18).toFixed(2);
  }, [healthFactorData]);

  const assetAddress = asset.address;

    return (parseFloat(repayAmount) * price).toFixed(2);

                      </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2">

                    <button
                      onClick={() => setRepayAmount("0")}

                    >
                      MAX
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Borrow APY</p>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.borrowAPY}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Health factor</p>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.healthFactor}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Liquidation at &lt;1.0</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={handleRepay}
                  disabled={!repayAmount || parseFloat(repayAmount) <= 0}
                  className={`w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ${
                    repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0
                      ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 via-green-400 to-cyan-400 hover:from-yellow-500 hover:via-green-500 hover:to-cyan-500 text-white hover-glow"
                      : "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
                  }`}
                >
                  {repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0 ? "Repay" : "Enter an amount"}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Modals */}
      <SupplyModal
        isOpen={supplyModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setSupplyModalOpen(false)}
        asset={{
          symbol: asset.symbol,
          name: asset.name,
          icon: asset.icon,
          balance: "0",
          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      <WithdrawModal
        isOpen={withdrawModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setWithdrawModalOpen(false)}
        asset={{
          symbol: asset.symbol,
          name: asset.name,
          icon: asset.icon,
          balance: "0",
          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      {borrowModalOpen && (
        <BorrowModal
          isOpen={borrowModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setBorrowModalOpen(false)}
          asset={{
            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}
      {repayModalOpen && (
        <RepayModal
          isOpen={repayModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setRepayModalOpen(false)}
          asset={{
            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, Info, Copy, ExternalLink, Fuel } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useAccount } from "wagmi";
import SupplyModal from "./SupplyModal";
import WithdrawModal from "./WithdrawModal";
import BorrowModal from "./BorrowModal";
import RepayModal from "./RepayModal";
import { useAssetDetails } from "@/hooks/useAssetDetails";
import { useHealthFactor, useTokenBalance, useSupplyBalance, useAvailableBorrow, useBorrowBalance, usePriceFromOracle } from "@/hooks/useContract";
import { ConfigService } from "@/services/configService";
import { formatUSD, formatBalance } from "@/utils/format";
import { formatUnits } from "viem";
import { getContractAddress } from "@/config/contracts";

interface AssetDetailsViewProps {
  assetSymbol: string;
}

export default function AssetDetailsView({ assetSymbol }: AssetDetailsViewProps) {
  const { isConnected } = useAccount();
  const assetDetails = useAssetDetails(assetSymbol);

  // Fallback if asset not found
  if (!assetDetails) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="text-center py-12">
          <p className="text-white text-lg">Asset {assetSymbol} not found</p>
          <Link href="/markets" className="text-green-400 hover:text-green-300 mt-4 inline-block">
            Back to Markets
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const asset = assetDetails.asset;
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"supply" | "withdraw" | "borrow" | "repay">("supply");
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState<"30D" | "6M" | "1Y">("30D");
  const [showInfo, setShowInfo] = useState<"supply" | "borrow" | null>(null);

  // Form state for each action
  const [supplyAmount, setSupplyAmount] = useState("");
  const [withdrawAmount, setWithdrawAmount] = useState("");
  const [borrowAmount, setBorrowAmount] = useState("");
  const [repayAmount, setRepayAmount] = useState("");

  const [supplyModalOpen, setSupplyModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [withdrawModalOpen, setWithdrawModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [borrowModalOpen, setBorrowModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [repayModalOpen, setRepayModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Get real-time user data
  const { data: healthFactorData } = useHealthFactor(isConnected);
  const { data: walletBalanceRaw } = useTokenBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: supplyBalanceRaw } = useSupplyBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: availableBorrowRaw } = useAvailableBorrow(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: borrowBalanceRaw } = useBorrowBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { price } = usePriceFromOracle(assetSymbol, isConnected);

  // Format balances
  const walletBalance = walletBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(walletBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const supplyBalance = supplyBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(supplyBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";

                >

      <SupplyModal

      {borrowModalOpen && (
        <BorrowModal

            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, Info, Copy, ExternalLink, Fuel } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

import { useHealthFactor, useTokenBalance, useSupplyBalance, useAvailableBorrow, useBorrowBalance, usePriceFromOracle } from "@/hooks/useContract";
import { ConfigService } from "@/services/configService";
import { formatUSD, formatBalance } from "@/utils/format";
import { formatUnits } from "viem";
import { getContractAddress } from "@/config/contracts";

interface AssetDetailsViewProps {
  assetSymbol: string;
}

export default function AssetDetailsView({ assetSymbol }: AssetDetailsViewProps) {
  const { isConnected } = useAccount();
  const assetDetails = useAssetDetails(assetSymbol);

  // Fallback if asset not found
  if (!assetDetails) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="text-center py-12">
          <p className="text-white text-lg">Asset {assetSymbol} not found</p>
          <Link href="/markets" className="text-green-400 hover:text-green-300 mt-4 inline-block">
            Back to Markets
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const asset = assetDetails.asset;
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"supply" | "withdraw" | "borrow" | "repay">("supply");
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState<"30D" | "6M" | "1Y">("30D");
  const [showInfo, setShowInfo] = useState<"supply" | "borrow" | null>(null);

  // Form state for each action
  const [supplyAmount, setSupplyAmount] = useState("");
  const [withdrawAmount, setWithdrawAmount] = useState("");
  const [borrowAmount, setBorrowAmount] = useState("");
  const [repayAmount, setRepayAmount] = useState("");

  const [supplyModalOpen, setSupplyModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [withdrawModalOpen, setWithdrawModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [borrowModalOpen, setBorrowModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [repayModalOpen, setRepayModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Get real-time user data
  const { data: healthFactorData } = useHealthFactor(isConnected);
  const { data: walletBalanceRaw } = useTokenBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: supplyBalanceRaw } = useSupplyBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: availableBorrowRaw } = useAvailableBorrow(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: borrowBalanceRaw } = useBorrowBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { price } = usePriceFromOracle(assetSymbol, isConnected);

  // Format balances
  const walletBalance = walletBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(walletBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const supplyBalance = supplyBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(supplyBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const availableBorrow = availableBorrowRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(availableBorrowRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const borrowBalance = borrowBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(borrowBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";

  // Calculate health factor
  const healthFactor = useMemo(() => {
    if (!healthFactorData) return "∞";
    const hf = Number(healthFactorData);
    if (hf === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER || hf > 1e18) return "∞";
    return (hf / 1e18).toFixed(2);
  }, [healthFactorData]);

  const assetAddress = asset.address;
  const explorerUrl = `https://zentrace.io/address/${assetAddress}`;
  
  // Calculate USD values
  const supplyAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!supplyAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(supplyAmount) * price).toFixed(2);

  const withdrawAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!withdrawAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(withdrawAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [withdrawAmount, price]);

  const borrowAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!borrowAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(borrowAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [borrowAmount, price]);

  const repayAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!repayAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(repayAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [repayAmount, price]);

    navigator.clipboard.writeText(assetAddress);

  };

      setSupplyAmount("");

        <span className="text-white">{asset.symbol}</span>

                    >
                      MAX
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Borrow APY</p>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.borrowAPY}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Health factor</p>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.healthFactor}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Liquidation at &lt;1.0</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={handleRepay}
                  disabled={!repayAmount || parseFloat(repayAmount) <= 0}
                  className={`w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ${
                    repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0
                      ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 via-green-400 to-cyan-400 hover:from-yellow-500 hover:via-green-500 hover:to-cyan-500 text-white hover-glow"
                      : "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
                  }`}
                >
                  {repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0 ? "Repay" : "Enter an amount"}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Modals */}
      <SupplyModal
        isOpen={supplyModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setSupplyModalOpen(false)}
        asset={{
          symbol: asset.symbol,
          name: asset.name,
          icon: asset.icon,
          balance: "0",
          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      <WithdrawModal
        isOpen={withdrawModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setWithdrawModalOpen(false)}
        asset={{
          symbol: asset.symbol,
          name: asset.name,
          icon: asset.icon,
          balance: "0",
          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      {borrowModalOpen && (
        <BorrowModal
          isOpen={borrowModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setBorrowModalOpen(false)}
          asset={{
            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}
      {repayModalOpen && (
        <RepayModal
          isOpen={repayModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setRepayModalOpen(false)}
          asset={{
            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";

import { useHealthFactor, useTokenBalance, useSupplyBalance, useAvailableBorrow, useBorrowBalance, usePriceFromOracle } from "@/hooks/useContract";
import { ConfigService } from "@/services/configService";
import { formatUSD, formatBalance } from "@/utils/format";
import { formatUnits } from "viem";
import { getContractAddress } from "@/config/contracts";

interface AssetDetailsViewProps {
  assetSymbol: string;
}

export default function AssetDetailsView({ assetSymbol }: AssetDetailsViewProps) {
  const { isConnected } = useAccount();
  const assetDetails = useAssetDetails(assetSymbol);

  // Fallback if asset not found
  if (!assetDetails) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="text-center py-12">
          <p className="text-white text-lg">Asset {assetSymbol} not found</p>

            Back to Markets
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const asset = assetDetails.asset;
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"supply" | "withdraw" | "borrow" | "repay">("supply");
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState<"30D" | "6M" | "1Y">("30D");
  const [showInfo, setShowInfo] = useState<"supply" | "borrow" | null>(null);

  // Form state for each action

  const [withdrawAmount, setWithdrawAmount] = useState("");
  const [borrowAmount, setBorrowAmount] = useState("");
  const [repayAmount, setRepayAmount] = useState("");

  const [supplyModalOpen, setSupplyModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [withdrawModalOpen, setWithdrawModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [borrowModalOpen, setBorrowModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [repayModalOpen, setRepayModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Get real-time user data
  const { data: healthFactorData } = useHealthFactor(isConnected);
  const { data: walletBalanceRaw } = useTokenBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: supplyBalanceRaw } = useSupplyBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: availableBorrowRaw } = useAvailableBorrow(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: borrowBalanceRaw } = useBorrowBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { price } = usePriceFromOracle(assetSymbol, isConnected);

  // Format balances
  const walletBalance = walletBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(walletBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const supplyBalance = supplyBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(supplyBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const availableBorrow = availableBorrowRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(availableBorrowRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const borrowBalance = borrowBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(borrowBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";

  // Calculate health factor
  const healthFactor = useMemo(() => {
    if (!healthFactorData) return "∞";
    const hf = Number(healthFactorData);
    if (hf === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER || hf > 1e18) return "∞";
    return (hf / 1e18).toFixed(2);
  }, [healthFactorData]);

  const assetAddress = asset.address;
  const explorerUrl = `https://zentrace.io/address/${assetAddress}`;
  
  // Calculate USD values
  const supplyAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!supplyAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(supplyAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [supplyAmount, price]);

  const withdrawAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!withdrawAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(withdrawAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [withdrawAmount, price]);

  const borrowAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!borrowAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(borrowAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [borrowAmount, price]);

  const repayAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!repayAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(repayAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [repayAmount, price]);

    navigator.clipboard.writeText(assetAddress);

  };

  };

                <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">

                <button

      <WithdrawModal
        isOpen={withdrawModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setWithdrawModalOpen(false)}
        asset={{
          symbol: asset.symbol,
          name: asset.name,
          icon: asset.icon,
          balance: "0",
          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      {borrowModalOpen && (
        <BorrowModal
          isOpen={borrowModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setBorrowModalOpen(false)}

            symbol: asset.symbol,

            icon: asset.icon,

          }}
        />
      )}
      {repayModalOpen && (
        <RepayModal
          isOpen={repayModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setRepayModalOpen(false)}

            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, Info, Copy, ExternalLink, Fuel } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useAccount } from "wagmi";
import SupplyModal from "./SupplyModal";
import WithdrawModal from "./WithdrawModal";
import BorrowModal from "./BorrowModal";
import RepayModal from "./RepayModal";
import { useAssetDetails } from "@/hooks/useAssetDetails";
import { useHealthFactor, useTokenBalance, useSupplyBalance, useAvailableBorrow, useBorrowBalance, usePriceFromOracle } from "@/hooks/useContract";
import { ConfigService } from "@/services/configService";
import { formatUSD, formatBalance } from "@/utils/format";
import { formatUnits } from "viem";
import { getContractAddress } from "@/config/contracts";

interface AssetDetailsViewProps {
  assetSymbol: string;
}

export default function AssetDetailsView({ assetSymbol }: AssetDetailsViewProps) {
  const { isConnected } = useAccount();
  const assetDetails = useAssetDetails(assetSymbol);

  // Fallback if asset not found
  if (!assetDetails) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="text-center py-12">
          <p className="text-white text-lg">Asset {assetSymbol} not found</p>
          <Link href="/markets" className="text-green-400 hover:text-green-300 mt-4 inline-block">
            Back to Markets
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const asset = assetDetails.asset;
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"supply" | "withdraw" | "borrow" | "repay">("supply");
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState<"30D" | "6M" | "1Y">("30D");
  const [showInfo, setShowInfo] = useState<"supply" | "borrow" | null>(null);

  // Form state for each action
  const [supplyAmount, setSupplyAmount] = useState("");
  const [withdrawAmount, setWithdrawAmount] = useState("");
  const [borrowAmount, setBorrowAmount] = useState("");
  const [repayAmount, setRepayAmount] = useState("");

  const [supplyModalOpen, setSupplyModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [withdrawModalOpen, setWithdrawModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [borrowModalOpen, setBorrowModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [repayModalOpen, setRepayModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Get real-time user data
  const { data: healthFactorData } = useHealthFactor(isConnected);
  const { data: walletBalanceRaw } = useTokenBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: supplyBalanceRaw } = useSupplyBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: availableBorrowRaw } = useAvailableBorrow(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: borrowBalanceRaw } = useBorrowBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { price } = usePriceFromOracle(assetSymbol, isConnected);

  // Format balances
  const walletBalance = walletBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(walletBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const supplyBalance = supplyBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(supplyBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const availableBorrow = availableBorrowRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(availableBorrowRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const borrowBalance = borrowBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(borrowBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";

  // Calculate health factor
  const healthFactor = useMemo(() => {
    if (!healthFactorData) return "∞";
    const hf = Number(healthFactorData);
    if (hf === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER || hf > 1e18) return "∞";
    return (hf / 1e18).toFixed(2);
  }, [healthFactorData]);

  const assetAddress = asset.address;
  const explorerUrl = `https://zentrace.io/address/${assetAddress}`;
  
  // Calculate USD values
  const supplyAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!supplyAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(supplyAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [supplyAmount, price]);

  const withdrawAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!withdrawAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(withdrawAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [withdrawAmount, price]);

  const borrowAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!borrowAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(borrowAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [borrowAmount, price]);

  const repayAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!repayAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(repayAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [repayAmount, price]);

  const handleCopyAddress = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(assetAddress);
    // TODO: Show toast notification
  };

  // Handler functions for direct action execution (without modals)
  const handleSupply = () => {
    if (supplyAmount && parseFloat(supplyAmount) > 0) {
      // TODO: Implement blockchain integration
      console.log("Supply", supplyAmount, asset.symbol);
      // Reset form after successful transaction
      setSupplyAmount("");
    }
  };

  const handleWithdraw = () => {
    if (withdrawAmount && parseFloat(withdrawAmount) > 0) {
      // TODO: Implement blockchain integration
      console.log("Withdraw", withdrawAmount, asset.symbol);
      // Reset form after successful transaction
      setWithdrawAmount("");
    }
  };

  const handleBorrow = () => {
    if (borrowAmount && parseFloat(borrowAmount) > 0 && assetDetails.totalBorrowed.amount !== "-") {
      // TODO: Implement blockchain integration
      console.log("Borrow", borrowAmount, asset.symbol);
      // Reset form after successful transaction
      setBorrowAmount("");
    }
  };

  const handleRepay = () => {
    if (repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0) {
      // TODO: Implement blockchain integration
      console.log("Repay", repayAmount, asset.symbol);
      // Reset form after successful transaction
      setRepayAmount("");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      {/* Breadcrumb Navigation */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-6 text-sm animate-fade-in">
        <Link
          href="/markets"
          className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gradient-zen transition-colors duration-300"
        >
          Markets
        </Link>
        <span className="text-gray-600">/</span>
        <span className="text-white">{asset.symbol}</span>
      </div>

      {/* Asset Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6 animate-fade-in">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Link
            href="/markets"
            className="p-2 hover:bg-gradient-to-r hover:from-yellow-400/10 hover:via-green-400/10 hover:to-cyan-400/10 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 text-gray-400 hover:text-green-400 border border-transparent hover:border-green-400/30"
          >

                  disabled={!withdrawAmount || parseFloat(withdrawAmount) <= 0}
                  className={`w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ${

                      : "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"

                >

                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {activeTab === "borrow" && (

                      value={borrowAmount}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const value = e.target.value;
                        if (value === "" || /^\d*\.?\d*$/.test(value)) {
                          setBorrowAmount(value);
                        }
                      }}
                      placeholder="0.00"
                      className="w-full bg-transparent text-2xl font-semibold text-white placeholder-gray-500 outline-none mb-2"
                    />

                    >

                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {asset.totalBorrowed === "-" && (

                      <Info className="w-3 h-3 text-gray-400" />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.borrowAPY}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={handleBorrow}
                  disabled={asset.totalBorrowed === "-" || !borrowAmount || parseFloat(borrowAmount) <= 0}
                  className={`w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ${
                    asset.totalBorrowed !== "-" && borrowAmount && parseFloat(borrowAmount) > 0
                      ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 via-green-400 to-cyan-400 hover:from-yellow-500 hover:via-green-500 hover:to-cyan-500 text-white hover-glow"
                      : "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
                  }`}
                >
                  {asset.totalBorrowed === "-"
                    ? "Enter valid amount"
                    : borrowAmount && parseFloat(borrowAmount) > 0
                    ? "Borrow"
                    : "Enter an amount"}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {activeTab === "repay" && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4">
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={repayAmount}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const value = e.target.value;
                        if (value === "" || /^\d*\.?\d*$/.test(value)) {
                          setRepayAmount(value);
                        }
                      }}
                      placeholder="0.00"
                      className="w-full bg-transparent text-2xl font-semibold text-white placeholder-gray-500 outline-none mb-2"
                    />
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">
                        ${repayAmount ? (parseFloat(repayAmount) * 60000).toFixed(2) : "0"}
                      </p>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-yellow-400/20 via-green-400/20 to-cyan-400/20 flex items-center justify-center text-sm border border-green-400/30 shadow-lg shadow-green-500/20 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110">
                          {asset.icon}
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.symbol}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Borrow balance 0</p>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setRepayAmount("0")}
                      className="px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-gradient-zen hover:opacity-80 transition-all duration-300"
                    >
                      MAX
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Borrow APY</p>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.borrowAPY}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Health factor</p>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.healthFactor}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Liquidation at &lt;1.0</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={handleRepay}
                  disabled={!repayAmount || parseFloat(repayAmount) <= 0}
                  className={`w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ${
                    repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0
                      ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 via-green-400 to-cyan-400 hover:from-yellow-500 hover:via-green-500 hover:to-cyan-500 text-white hover-glow"
                      : "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
                  }`}
                >
                  {repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0 ? "Repay" : "Enter an amount"}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Modals */}
      <SupplyModal
        isOpen={supplyModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setSupplyModalOpen(false)}
        asset={{
          symbol: asset.symbol,
          name: asset.name,
          icon: asset.icon,
          balance: "0",
          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      <WithdrawModal
        isOpen={withdrawModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setWithdrawModalOpen(false)}
        asset={{
          symbol: asset.symbol,
          name: asset.name,
          icon: asset.icon,
          balance: "0",
          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      {borrowModalOpen && (
        <BorrowModal
          isOpen={borrowModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setBorrowModalOpen(false)}
          asset={{
            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}
      {repayModalOpen && (
        <RepayModal
          isOpen={repayModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setRepayModalOpen(false)}
          asset={{
            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
import { useHealthFactor, useTokenBalance, useSupplyBalance, useAvailableBorrow, useBorrowBalance, usePriceFromOracle } from "@/hooks/useContract";

import { formatUSD, formatBalance } from "@/utils/format";
import { formatUnits } from "viem";
import { getContractAddress } from "@/config/contracts";

interface AssetDetailsViewProps {
  assetSymbol: string;
}

export default function AssetDetailsView({ assetSymbol }: AssetDetailsViewProps) {
  const { isConnected } = useAccount();
  const assetDetails = useAssetDetails(assetSymbol);

  // Fallback if asset not found
  if (!assetDetails) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="text-center py-12">
          <p className="text-white text-lg">Asset {assetSymbol} not found</p>

            Back to Markets
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const asset = assetDetails.asset;
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"supply" | "withdraw" | "borrow" | "repay">("supply");
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState<"30D" | "6M" | "1Y">("30D");
  const [showInfo, setShowInfo] = useState<"supply" | "borrow" | null>(null);

  const [borrowModalOpen, setBorrowModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [repayModalOpen, setRepayModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Get real-time user data
  const { data: healthFactorData } = useHealthFactor(isConnected);
  const { data: walletBalanceRaw } = useTokenBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: supplyBalanceRaw } = useSupplyBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: availableBorrowRaw } = useAvailableBorrow(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: borrowBalanceRaw } = useBorrowBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { price } = usePriceFromOracle(assetSymbol, isConnected);

  // Format balances
  const walletBalance = walletBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(walletBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const supplyBalance = supplyBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(supplyBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const availableBorrow = availableBorrowRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(availableBorrowRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const borrowBalance = borrowBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(borrowBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";

  // Calculate health factor
  const healthFactor = useMemo(() => {
    if (!healthFactorData) return "∞";
    const hf = Number(healthFactorData);
    if (hf === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER || hf > 1e18) return "∞";
    return (hf / 1e18).toFixed(2);

                  className={`w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ${
                    repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0
                      ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 via-green-400 to-cyan-400 hover:from-yellow-500 hover:via-green-500 hover:to-cyan-500 text-white hover-glow"

        asset={{

          name: asset.name,
          icon: asset.icon,

          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      {borrowModalOpen && (
        <BorrowModal
          isOpen={borrowModalOpen}

            symbol: asset.symbol,

      {repayModalOpen && (

          isOpen={repayModalOpen}

          asset={{
            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}

  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
                    </p>
                  </div>
                )}

                {assetDetails.totalBorrowed.amount !== "-" && (
                  <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Borrow APY, variable</p>
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{assetDetails.borrowAPY}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Health factor</p>
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{healthFactor}</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Liquidation at &lt;1.0</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                <button
                  onClick={handleBorrow}
                  disabled={assetDetails.totalBorrowed.amount === "-" || !borrowAmount || parseFloat(borrowAmount) <= 0}
                  className={`w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ${
                    assetDetails.totalBorrowed.amount !== "-" && borrowAmount && parseFloat(borrowAmount) > 0
                      ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 via-green-400 to-cyan-400 hover:from-yellow-500 hover:via-green-500 hover:to-cyan-500 text-white hover-glow"
                      : "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
                  }`}
                >
                  {assetDetails.totalBorrowed.amount === "-"
                    ? "Enable collateral first"
                    : borrowAmount && parseFloat(borrowAmount) > 0
                    ? "Borrow"
                    : "Enter an amount"}
                </button>
```

```typescriptreact
                <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Borrow APY</p>

                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{healthFactor}</p>

                <button

                  className={`w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ${

      <WithdrawModal
        isOpen={withdrawModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setWithdrawModalOpen(false)}
        asset={{
          symbol: asset.symbol,
          name: asset.name,
          icon: asset.icon,
          balance: "0",
          balanceUSD: "$0",
          apy: asset.currentAPY,
          healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
        }}
      />
      {borrowModalOpen && (
        <BorrowModal
          isOpen={borrowModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setBorrowModalOpen(false)}

            symbol: asset.symbol,

      )}
      {repayModalOpen && (
        <RepayModal
          isOpen={repayModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setRepayModalOpen(false)}

            symbol: asset.symbol,
            name: asset.name,
            icon: asset.icon,
            borrowAPY: asset.borrowAPY,
            healthFactor: asset.healthFactor,
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, Info, Copy, ExternalLink, Fuel } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useAccount } from "wagmi";
import SupplyModal from "./SupplyModal";
import WithdrawModal from "./WithdrawModal";
import BorrowModal from "./BorrowModal";
import RepayModal from "./RepayModal";
import { useAssetDetails } from "@/hooks/useAssetDetails";
import { useHealthFactor, useTokenBalance, useSupplyBalance, useAvailableBorrow, useBorrowBalance, usePriceFromOracle } from "@/hooks/useContract";
import { ConfigService } from "@/services/configService";
import { formatUSD, formatBalance } from "@/utils/format";
import { formatUnits } from "viem";
import { getContractAddress } from "@/config/contracts";

interface AssetDetailsViewProps {
  assetSymbol: string;
}

export default function AssetDetailsView({ assetSymbol }: AssetDetailsViewProps) {
  const { isConnected } = useAccount();
  const assetDetails = useAssetDetails(assetSymbol);

  // Fallback if asset not found
  if (!assetDetails) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="text-center py-12">
          <p className="text-white text-lg">Asset {assetSymbol} not found</p>
          <Link href="/markets" className="text-green-400 hover:text-green-300 mt-4 inline-block">
            Back to Markets
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const asset = assetDetails.asset;
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"supply" | "withdraw" | "borrow" | "repay">("supply");
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState<"30D" | "6M" | "1Y">("30D");
  const [showInfo, setShowInfo] = useState<"supply" | "borrow" | null>(null);

  // Form state for each action
  const [supplyAmount, setSupplyAmount] = useState("");
  const [withdrawAmount, setWithdrawAmount] = useState("");
  const [borrowAmount, setBorrowAmount] = useState("");
  const [repayAmount, setRepayAmount] = useState("");

  const [supplyModalOpen, setSupplyModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [withdrawModalOpen, setWithdrawModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [borrowModalOpen, setBorrowModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [repayModalOpen, setRepayModalOpen] = useState(false);

  // Get real-time user data
  const { data: healthFactorData } = useHealthFactor(isConnected);
  const { data: walletBalanceRaw } = useTokenBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: supplyBalanceRaw } = useSupplyBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: availableBorrowRaw } = useAvailableBorrow(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { data: borrowBalanceRaw } = useBorrowBalance(assetSymbol, isConnected);
  const { price } = usePriceFromOracle(assetSymbol, isConnected);

  // Format balances
  const walletBalance = walletBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(walletBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const supplyBalance = supplyBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(supplyBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const availableBorrow = availableBorrowRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(availableBorrowRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";
  const borrowBalance = borrowBalanceRaw ? formatBalance(formatUnits(borrowBalanceRaw, asset.decimals)) : "0.00";

  // Calculate health factor
  const healthFactor = useMemo(() => {
    if (!healthFactorData) return "∞";
    const hf = Number(healthFactorData);
    if (hf === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER || hf > 1e18) return "∞";
    return (hf / 1e18).toFixed(2);
  }, [healthFactorData]);

  const assetAddress = asset.address;
  const explorerUrl = `https://zentrace.io/address/${assetAddress}`;
  
  // Calculate USD values
  const supplyAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!supplyAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(supplyAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [supplyAmount, price]);

  const withdrawAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!withdrawAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(withdrawAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [withdrawAmount, price]);

  const borrowAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!borrowAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(borrowAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [borrowAmount, price]);

  const repayAmountUSD = useMemo(() => {
    if (!repayAmount || !price) return "0";
    return (parseFloat(repayAmount) * price).toFixed(2);
  }, [repayAmount, price]);

  const handleCopyAddress = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(assetAddress);
    // TODO: Show toast notification
  };

  // Handler functions for direct action execution (without modals)
  const handleSupply = () => {
    if (supplyAmount && parseFloat(supplyAmount) > 0) {
      // TODO: Implement blockchain integration
      console.log("Supply", supplyAmount, asset.symbol);
      // Reset form after successful transaction
      setSupplyAmount("");
    }
  };

  const handleWithdraw = () => {
    if (withdrawAmount && parseFloat(withdrawAmount) > 0) {
      // TODO: Implement blockchain integration
      console.log("Withdraw", withdrawAmount, asset.symbol);
      // Reset form after successful transaction
      setWithdrawAmount("");
    }
  };

  const handleBorrow = () => {
    if (borrowAmount && parseFloat(borrowAmount) > 0 && assetDetails.totalBorrowed.amount !== "-") {
      // TODO: Implement blockchain integration
      console.log("Borrow", borrowAmount, asset.symbol);
      // Reset form after successful transaction
      setBorrowAmount("");
    }
  };

  const handleRepay = () => {
    if (repayAmount && parseFloat(repayAmount) > 0) {
      // TODO: Implement blockchain integration
      console.log("Repay", repayAmount, asset.symbol);
      // Reset form after successful transaction
      setRepayAmount("");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      {/* Breadcrumb Navigation */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-6 text-sm animate-fade-in">
        <Link
          href="/markets"
          className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gradient-zen transition-colors duration-300"
        >
          Markets
        </Link>
        <span className="text-gray-600">/</span>
        <span className="text-white">{asset.symbol}</span>
      </div>

      {/* Asset Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6 animate-fade-in">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Link
            href="/markets"
            className="p-2 hover:bg-gradient-to-r hover:from-yellow-400/10 hover:via-green-400/10 hover:to-cyan-400/10 rounded-lg transition-all duration-300 text-gray-400 hover:text-green-400 border border-transparent hover:border-green-400/30"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
          </Link>
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-yellow-400/20 via-green-400/20 to-cyan-400/20 flex items-center justify-center text-2xl border-2 border-green-400/50 shadow-lg shadow-green-500/20 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110">
            {asset.icon}
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">
              <span className="text-white">{asset.name}</span>{" "}
              <span className="text-gradient-zen">(ZenChain Testnet Market)</span>
            </h1>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400/20 via-green-400/20 to-cyan-400/20 text-green-300 text-[10px] font-medium rounded-full border border-green-400/30 animate-pulse-glow">

                      onChange={(e) => {
```
