Adding the missing import in SupplyModal.tsx:


```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { X, Info, Fuel } from "lucide-react";
import { useAccount } from "wagmi";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useSupply, useTokenBalance, usePriceFromOracle, useHealthFactor } from "@/hooks/useContract";
import { ConfigService } from "@/services/configService";
import { formatBalance, formatUSD } from "@/utils/format";
import { formatUnits } from "viem";
import { useTokenDecimals } from "@/hooks/useBalance";

interface SupplyModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  asset: {
    symbol: string;
    name: string;
    icon: string;
    balance?: string;
    balanceUSD?: string;
    apy: string;
    healthFactor: string;
  };
}

export default function SupplyModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  asset,
}: SupplyModalProps) {
  const { isConnected } = useAccount();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("");
  const { supply, isPending, isConfirming, isSuccess, error } = useSupply();
  
  // Get wallet balance
  const { data: walletBalanceRaw } = useTokenBalance(asset.symbol, isConnected);
  const assetConfig = ConfigService.getAssetConfig(asset.symbol);
  const { data: tokenDecimals } = useTokenDecimals(asset.symbol, isConnected);
  
  // Use contract decimals if available, otherwise fall back to config
  const decimals = tokenDecimals !== undefined ? tokenDecimals : assetConfig?.decimals || 18;
  
  const walletBalance = walletBalanceRaw
    ? formatBalance(formatUnits(walletBalanceRaw, decimals))
    : "0";

  // Get price for USD value
  const { price } = usePriceFromOracle(asset.symbol, isConnected);
  
  // Get health factor
  const { data: healthFactorData } = useHealthFactor(isConnected);
  const healthFactor = healthFactorData 
    ? (Number(healthFactorData) > 1e18 ? Infinity : Number(healthFactorData) / 1e18)
    : Infinity;

  // Calculate USD value
  const usdValue = price && amount 
    ? (parseFloat(amount) * price).toFixed(2)
    : "0";

  // Handle success - close modal and reset
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSuccess) {
      // Invalidate all queries to ensure data refreshes
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [] });
      
      // Wait for block confirmation and query refetch, then close modal
      setTimeout(() => {
        // Force refetch all queries
        queryClient.refetchQueries({ queryKey: [] });
        onClose();
        setAmount("");
      }, 3000);
    }
  }, [isSuccess, onClose, queryClient]);

  const handleMax = () => {
    setAmount(walletBalance);
  };

  const handleAmountChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    // Allow numbers and one decimal point
    if (value === "" || /^\d*\.?\d*$/.test(value)) {
      setAmount(value);
    }
  };

  const handleSupply = async () => {
    if (!isValidAmount || !assetConfig) return;
    try {
      await supply(asset.symbol, amount);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Supply error:", err);
    }
  };

  const isValidAmount =
    amount &&
    parseFloat(amount) > 0 &&
    parseFloat(amount) <= parseFloat(walletBalance);
  
  const isLoading = isPending || isConfirming;

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      {/* Backdrop */}
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm"
        onClick={onClose}
      />

      {/* Modal */}
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-[#0f1422] rounded-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-6 border-b border-white/10">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Supply {asset.symbol}</h2>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-lg transition-colors text-gray-400 hover:text-white"
            aria-label="Close modal"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        <div className="p-6 space-y-6">
          {/* Amount Input */}
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
              <label className="text-sm text-gray-400">Amount</label>
              <button
                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-help"
                title="Enter the amount you want to supply"
                aria-label="Amount info"
              >
                <Info className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2 gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={amount}
                  onChange={handleAmountChange}
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  className="bg-transparent text-2xl font-semibold text-white placeholder-gray-500 outline-none flex-1 min-w-0"
                />
                <div className="flex items-center flex-shrink-0">
                  <div className="text-right min-w-[60px]">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white whitespace-nowrap">{asset.symbol}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">${usdValue}</p>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Wallet balance {walletBalance}</p>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleMax}
                    className="px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-gradient-zen hover:opacity-80 transition-all duration-300"
                  >
                    MAX
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Transaction Overview */}
          <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-300">Transaction overview</h3>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Supply APY</p>
                  <button
                    className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-help"
                    title="Annual Percentage Yield for supplying this asset"
                    aria-label="APY info"
                  >
                    <Info className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </button>
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{asset.apy}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Collateralization</p>
                  <button
                    className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-help"
                    title="Whether this asset can be used as collateral"
                    aria-label="Collateralization info"
                  >
                    <Info className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </button>
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-green-400">Enabled</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Health factor</p>
                  <button
                    className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-help"
                    title="Your account health factor after this transaction"
                    aria-label="Health factor info"
                  >
                    <Info className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">
                    {healthFactor === Infinity ? "∞" : healthFactor.toFixed(2)}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Liquidation at &lt;1.0</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-white/10">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Fuel className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" />
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">Gas estimation</p>
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">-</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Action Button */}
          <button
            onClick={handleSupply}
            disabled={!isValidAmount || isLoading}
            className={`w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all duration-300 ${
              isValidAmount && !isLoading
                ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 via-green-400 to-cyan-400 hover:from-yellow-500 hover:via-green-500 hover:to-cyan-500 text-white cursor-pointer hover-glow"
                : "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
            }`}
          >
            {isLoading
              ? isConfirming
                ? "Confirming..."
                : "Processing..."
              : isSuccess
              ? "Success!"
              : isValidAmount
              ? "Supply"
              : "Enter an amount"}
          </button>
          
          {/* Error Message */}
          {error && (
            <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 rounded-lg">
              <p className="text-sm text-red-400">
                {error.message || "Transaction failed. Please try again."}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
          
          {/* Success Message */}
          {isSuccess && (
            <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-green-500/10 border border-green-500/20 rounded-lg">
              <p className="text-sm text-green-400">
                Successfully supplied {amount} {asset.symbol}!
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


```

## Changes made

### 1. Query invalidation after transactions
   - Updated `useSupply`, `useWithdraw`, `useBorrow`, and `useRepay` hooks to invalidate and refetch all queries after successful transactions
   - Added `confirmations: 1` to wait for block confirmation before refetching
   - Added both `invalidateQueries` and `refetchQueries` calls

### 2. Automatic refresh
   - Updated React Query config to refetch every 10 seconds
   - Reduced staleTime to 5 seconds so data is considered stale faster
   - Added automatic refetch in `SupplyRow` component every 10 seconds when connected

### 3. Manual refresh button
   - Added a refresh button (RefreshCw icon) in the "Your Supplies" section
   - Button invalidates and refetches all queries when clicked
   - Shows a spinning animation while refreshing

### 4. Improved modal handling
   - Updated `SupplyModal` to invalidate queries when the transaction succeeds
   - Extended wait time to 3 seconds to allow block confirmation and refetch
   - Added query client invalidation in the success handler

### 5. Better query configuration
   - Updated query client defaults to refetch more frequently
   - Added `refetchInterval: 10000` for automatic polling
   - Set `refetchOnWindowFocus: true` and `refetchOnMount: true`

## How it works now

1. After a successful supply transaction:
   - Wait for 1 block confirmation
   - Invalidate all React Query cache entries
   - Refetch all queries after 1 second
   - Modal closes after 3 seconds (after data refreshes)

2. Automatic updates:
   - Queries refetch every 10 seconds
   - Data is considered stale after 5 seconds
   - Refetch on window focus and component mount

3. Manual refresh:
   - Click the refresh button in the "Your Supplies" header
   - Forces an immediate refetch of all data

## Testing

After your next supply transaction:
1. Wait 2–3 seconds after the transaction succeeds
2. Your supplied asset should appear in "Your Supplies"
3. If it doesn’t, click the refresh button
4. The balance should update automatically within 10 seconds

The dashboard should now show your supplied assets after transactions complete. If you still don’t see updates, verify:
- Your `.env.local` file has the correct deployed contract addresses
- The transaction was successful on-chain (check the block explorer)
- Your wallet is connected to the correct network (Zenchain Testnet)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Dependencies
- **ethers.js**: 6.9+ (already installed)
- **viem**: 2.7+ (already installed)

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

- Implement kinked interest rate model
- Base rate: 2%
- Slope1: 8% (utilization < 75%)
- Slope2: 50% (utilization >= 75%)
- Calculate borrow rate based on utilization
- Calculate supply APY (borrow rate × (1 - reserve factor))

- Borrow function: Check collateral, borrow assets
- Repay function: Repay borrowed assets
- Health factor calculation
- Collateral management
- Event emissions for all operations

- ERC20 token with interest accrual
- Exchange rate tracking

- Transfer functionality

- Add/remove supported assets
- Store asset configuration (LTV, thresholds)

#### Step 2.7: Reserve Manager (`contracts/contracts/registry/ReserveManager.sol`)
- Reserve factor: 10%

- Dashboard page (all asset prices)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Dependencies
- **ethers.js**: 6.9+ (already installed)
- **viem**: 2.7+ (already installed)

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

## 🔐 Phase 2: Smart Contracts

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 2.1: Set Up Contract Structure
```
contracts/
  contracts/
    core/
      ZenFinancePool.sol       # Main lending pool
      Oracle.sol                # Price oracle
      InterestRateModel.sol     # Interest rate calculations
      LiquidationEngine.sol     # Liquidation logic
      AToken.sol                # Interest-bearing tokens
    registry/
      AssetRegistry.sol         # Asset management
      ReserveManager.sol        # Reserve management
    interfaces/
      IERC20.sol
      IZenFinance.sol
      IOracle.sol
  test/
    ZenFinancePool.test.ts
    Oracle.test.ts
    ...
```

#### Step 2.2: Price Oracle Contract (`contracts/contracts/core/Oracle.sol`)
- Implement price fetching from DEX pairs
- Support direct USDC pairs
- Support intermediate routing (ZFI via ZTC)
- Cache prices with timestamps (5-minute cache)
- Emergency fallback prices
- Events for price updates

#### Step 2.3: Interest Rate Model (`contracts/contracts/core/InterestRateModel.sol`)
- Implement kinked interest rate model
- Base rate: 2%
- Slope1: 8% (utilization < 75%)
- Slope2: 50% (utilization >= 75%)
- Calculate borrow rate based on utilization
- Calculate supply APY (borrow rate × (1 - reserve factor))

#### Step 2.4: Lending Pool Contract (`contracts/contracts/core/ZenFinancePool.sol`)
- Supply function: Deposit assets, mint aTokens
- Withdraw function: Burn aTokens, withdraw assets
- Borrow function: Check collateral, borrow assets
- Repay function: Repay borrowed assets
- Health factor calculation
- Collateral management
- Event emissions for all operations

#### Step 2.5: AToken Contract (`contracts/contracts/core/AToken.sol`)
- ERC20 token with interest accrual
- Exchange rate tracking
- Mint/burn functionality
- Transfer functionality
- Interest distribution

#### Step 2.6: Asset Registry (`contracts/contracts/registry/AssetRegistry.sol`)
- Add/remove supported assets
- Store asset configuration (LTV, thresholds)
- Asset metadata storage
- OnlyOwner access control

#### Step 2.7: Reserve Manager (`contracts/contracts/registry/ReserveManager.sol`)
- Reserve factor: 10%
- Reserve accumulation
- Reserve distribution (future: to protocol)
- Reserve tracking

#### Step 2.8: Liquidation Engine (`contracts/contracts/core/LiquidationEngine.sol`)
- Health factor calculation
- Liquidation threshold: 80%
- Liquidation execution
- Collateral seizure
- Liquidation bonus (5%)

#### Step 2.9: Security Features
- OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard
- OpenZeppelin Ownable
- OpenZeppelin Pausable
- Input validation
- Access control

## 💰 Phase 4: Price Integration

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 4.1: Price Service (`frontend/services/priceService.ts`)
- Create service to fetch prices from DEX pairs
- Implement `getReserves()` calls to pair contracts
- Calculate prices from reserves

- Implement price caching (30-60 seconds)
- Error handling and fallbacks

#### Step 4.2: Price Utilities (`frontend/utils/priceUtils.ts`)
- Format prices (2 decimal places)
- Optimize large numbers (K, M)
- USD conversion helpers
- Price validation

#### Step 4.3: Price Hook (`frontend/hooks/usePrice.ts`)
- React hook for price fetching
- Automatic refresh intervals
- Price cache management
- Error handling
- Loading states

#### Step 4.4: Integrate Prices into Components
- Dashboard page (all asset prices)
- Markets page (market prices)
- Asset details page (asset price)
- Modals (USD value calculations)
- Balance calculations (USD equivalents)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Dependencies
- **ethers.js**: 6.9+ (already installed)
- **viem**: 2.7+ (already installed)

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

- [ ] Price service fetches reserves correctly
- [ ] Price calculation is correct for direct pairs
- [ ] Price calculation is correct for intermediate pairs

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

- Dashboard page (all asset prices)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Dependencies
- **ethers.js**: 6.9+ (already installed)
- **viem**: 2.7+ (already installed)

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

- Dashboard page (all asset prices)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Dependencies
- **ethers.js**: 6.9+ (already installed)
- **viem**: 2.7+ (already installed)

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

## 💰 Phase 4: Price Integration

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 4.1: Price Service (`frontend/services/priceService.ts`)
- Create service to fetch prices from DEX pairs
- Implement `getReserves()` calls to pair contracts
- Calculate prices from reserves
- Support direct USDC pairs

- Implement price caching (30-60 seconds)
- Error handling and fallbacks

#### Step 4.2: Price Utilities (`frontend/utils/priceUtils.ts`)
- Format prices (2 decimal places)
- Optimize large numbers (K, M)
- USD conversion helpers
- Price validation

#### Step 4.3: Price Hook (`frontend/hooks/usePrice.ts`)
- React hook for price fetching
- Automatic refresh intervals
- Price cache management
- Error handling

#### Step 4.4: Integrate Prices into Components
- Dashboard page (all asset prices)
- Markets page (market prices)
- Asset details page (asset price)
- Modals (USD value calculations)
- Balance calculations (USD equivalents)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Dependencies
- **ethers.js**: 6.9+ (already installed)
- **viem**: 2.7+ (already installed)

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

### 📝 Implementation Steps

- React hook for price fetching

#### Step 4.4: Integrate Prices into Components
- Dashboard page (all asset prices)
- Markets page (market prices)
- Asset details page (asset price)
- Modals (USD value calculations)
- Balance calculations (USD equivalents)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Dependencies
- **ethers.js**: 6.9+ (already installed)
- **viem**: 2.7+ (already installed)

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

## 💰 Phase 4: Price Integration

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 4.1: Price Service (`frontend/services/priceService.ts`)
- Create service to fetch prices from DEX pairs
- Implement `getReserves()` calls to pair contracts
- Calculate prices from reserves
- Support direct USDC pairs
- Support intermediate routing (ZFI via ZTC)
- Implement price caching (30-60 seconds)
- Error handling and fallbacks

#### Step 4.2: Price Utilities (`frontend/utils/priceUtils.ts`)
- Format prices (2 decimal places)
- Optimize large numbers (K, M)
- USD conversion helpers
- Price validation

#### Step 4.3: Price Hook (`frontend/hooks/usePrice.ts`)
- React hook for price fetching
- Automatic refresh intervals
- Price cache management
- Error handling
- Loading states

#### Step 4.4: Integrate Prices into Components
- Dashboard page (all asset prices)
- Markets page (market prices)
- Asset details page (asset price)
- Modals (USD value calculations)
- Balance calculations (USD equivalents)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Dependencies
- **ethers.js**: 6.9+ (already installed)
- **viem**: 2.7+ (already installed)

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Dependencies
- **ethers.js**: 6.9+ (already installed)
- **viem**: 2.7+ (already installed)

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Dependencies
- **ethers.js**: 6.9+ (already installed)
- **viem**: 2.7+ (already installed)

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (`frontend/services/apyService.ts`)
- Supply APY calculation (daily compounding)
- Borrow APY calculation
- Net APY calculation
- APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (`frontend/services/utilizationService.ts`)
- Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (`frontend/services/interestRateService.ts`)
- Kinked interest rate model
- Base rate + slope calculations
- Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (`frontend/services/healthFactorService.ts`)
- Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- Real-time health factor updates
- Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (`frontend/services/collateralService.ts`)
- Total collateral value
- Borrowed against collateral
- Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (`frontend/services/netWorthService.ts`)
- Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components
- Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Dependencies
- **ethers.js**: 6.9+ (already installed)
- **viem**: 2.7+ (already installed)

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (in hooks) ✅
- [x] Supply APY calculation (dynamic based on utilization)
- [x] Borrow APY calculation (dynamic based on utilization)
- [x] Net APY calculation
- [x] APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (in hooks) ✅
- [x] Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- [x] Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (in contracts) ✅
- [x] Kinked interest rate model
- [x] Base rate + slope calculations
- [x] Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (in hooks) ✅
- [x] Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- [x] Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- [x] Real-time health factor updates
- [x] Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (in hooks) ✅
- [x] Total collateral value
- [x] Borrowed against collateral
- [x] Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- [x] Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (in hooks) ✅
- [x] Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- [x] Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- [x] Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components ✅
- [x] Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- [x] Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- [x] Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- [x] Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (in hooks) ✅
- [x] Supply APY calculation (dynamic based on utilization)
- [x] Borrow APY calculation (dynamic based on utilization)
- [x] Net APY calculation
- [x] APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (in hooks) ✅
- [x] Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- [x] Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (in contracts) ✅
- [x] Kinked interest rate model
- [x] Base rate + slope calculations
- [x] Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (in hooks) ✅
- [x] Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- [x] Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- [x] Real-time health factor updates
- [x] Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (in hooks) ✅
- [x] Total collateral value
- [x] Borrowed against collateral
- [x] Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- [x] Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (in hooks) ✅
- [x] Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- [x] Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- [x] Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components ✅
- [x] Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- [x] Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- [x] Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- [x] Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Dependencies
- **ethers.js**: 6.9+ (already installed)
- **viem**: 2.7+ (already installed)

#### Pair Contract ABIs
```typescript
const PAIR_ABI = [
  "function getReserves() view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast)",
  "function token0() view returns (address)",
  "function token1() view returns (address)"
];

const ERC20_ABI = [
  "function decimals() view returns (uint8)",
  "function symbol() view returns (string)"
];
```

#### Price Calculation Logic
```typescript
// Direct pair: Token/USDC
price = reserveUSDC / reserveToken

// Intermediate: Token/ZTC → ZTC/USDC
priceTokenZTC = reserveZTC / reserveToken
priceZTCUSDC = reserveUSDC / reserveZTC
priceTokenUSDC = priceTokenZTC * priceZTCUSDC
```

## 📊 Phase 6: Calculations & Formulas

### 📝 Implementation Steps

#### Step 6.1: APY Service (in hooks) ✅

- [x] Borrow APY calculation (dynamic based on utilization)
- [x] Net APY calculation
- [x] APY formatting

#### Step 6.2: Utilization Service (in hooks) ✅
- [x] Utilization rate calculation: `(Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100`
- [x] Real-time updates

#### Step 6.3: Interest Rate Service (in contracts) ✅
- [x] Kinked interest rate model
- [x] Base rate + slope calculations
- [x] Utilization-based rates

#### Step 6.4: Health Factor Service (in hooks) ✅
- [x] Health factor calculation: `(Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD`
- [x] Liquidation threshold: 80% for all assets
- [x] Real-time health factor updates
- [x] Health factor warnings

#### Step 6.5: Collateral Service (in hooks) ✅
- [x] Total collateral value
- [x] Borrowed against collateral
- [x] Available borrowing power (75% LTV)
- [x] Collateral utilization

#### Step 6.6: Net Worth Service (in hooks) ✅
- [x] Net worth: `(Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)`
- [x] Net APY: `(Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)`
- [x] Real-time updates

#### Step 6.7: Integrate into Components ✅
- [x] Dashboard metrics (Net Worth, Net APY, Health Factor)
- [x] Your Supplies (Balance, APY, Collateral)
- [x] Your Borrows (Balance, APY, Borrow Power Used)
- [x] Assets to Borrow (Available balance)

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Formulas

##### APY Calculation (Daily Compounding)
```
APY = (1 + r/n)^n - 1
Where:
  r = annual interest rate (as decimal)
  n = 365 (daily compounding)
```

##### Utilization Rate
```
Utilization Rate = (Total Borrowed / Total Supplied) × 100
```

##### Borrow Rate (Kinked Model)
```
If utilization < 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + (Utilization / Optimal Utilization) × Slope1
If utilization >= 75%:
  Borrow Rate = Base Rate + Slope1 + ((Utilization - Optimal Utilization) / (100% - Optimal Utilization)) × Slope2
```

##### Supply APY
```
Supply APY = Borrow Rate × (1 - Reserve Factor) × Utilization
```

##### Health Factor
```
Health Factor = (Σ(supplied_value_USD × liquidation_threshold)) / total_borrowed_value_USD
Where:
  liquidation_threshold = 80% for all assets
```

##### Collateral
```
Collateral = Total USD value of assets borrowed against supplied assets
```

##### Net Worth
```
Net Worth = (Total Supplied Value) - (Total Borrowed Value)
```

##### Net APY
```
Net APY = (Sum of Supply APY) - (Sum of Borrow APY)
```

### 🔧 Technical Requirements

#### Dependencies
